description:
Free. How many credits a call to a SalesMap tool can use, before running it, against what the workspace can spend now (balance and limit). Not a charge: the most the call can use, which it reserves (or its max_credits); it uses 1 credit per account that qualifies, never more. When `fits` is false, `shortfallCredits` says how many more are needed and `topUp` is the link.
Use when: "how much will this cost", "can I afford 10 accounts", "how many credits would a discover for my site use".
Skip when: the user wants their balance or limits without a call in mind. Quoted page text is normalized; a quote that reads like an instruction keeps its text and is flagged in <field>Flags with the attack family.
